title: INSEP: Refusal-Direction Inseparability as a Defense Against Abliteration
abstract: arXiv:2611.28314v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Abliteration is a widely used white-box attack against the safety alignment of large language models (LLMs). It elicits harmful behavior by estimating a refusal direction in the model's activation space and projecting that direction out of the residual-stream write-out matrices. We propose INSEP, a defense that fine-tunes the model to reduce the separability of harmful and benign activations along the refusal direction. Abliteration estimates this direction as a difference in class means and projects it out. Reducing separability weakens the signal the attack relies on. An adversarial eigendecomposition selects the most separable prompt subsets. A low-rank adapter reduces their separation along that direction. Behavioral losses preserve the base model's refusal and the quality of its benign responses during training. translated_title: INSEP：以拒绝方向不可分性作为对抗Abliteration攻击的防御方法
translated_abstract: Abliteration是一种被广泛使用的针对大语言模型（LLM）安全对齐的白盒攻击。它通过在模型激活空间中估计一个“拒绝方向”，并将该方向从残差流的写出矩阵中投影去除，从而诱导出有害行为。我们提出INSEP，一种通过微调模型来降低有害激活与良性激活沿拒绝方向可分性的防御方法。Abliteration将该方向估计为类别均值之差并将其投影去除，而降低可分性会削弱该攻击所依赖的信号。该方法利用对抗性特征分解来选取可分性最强的提示子集，并通过低秩适配器降低这些子集沿该方向的分离程度。在训练过程中，行为损失用于保持基础模型的拒绝能力以及其良性回答的质量。我们在五种攻击下、跨越八个参数量从1B到14B的LLM上，将INSEP与六种已发表的防御方法进行了基准比较……
tldr: INSEP通过微调模型降低有害与良性激活沿拒绝方向的可分性，从而削弱Abliteration攻击所依赖的估计信号，实现对该白盒越狱攻击的有效防御。
en_tdlr: INSEP defends against the Abliteration attack by fine-tuning the model to reduce the separability of harmful and benign activations along the refusal direction, thereby weakening the signal that the attack relies on.
